breakfast.name: Idli (Steamed South Indian Rice Cakes)
breakfast.description: Soft, fluffy steamed rice cakes from South India, made from fermented batter and naturally gluten-free. Typically served with sambar and coconut chutney
instructions: Soak rice and urad dal separately for 6 hours
Add fenugreek seeds to urad dal
Grind urad dal into smooth paste, transfer to bowl
Grind rice into smooth paste
Mix both pastes together
Let ferment overnight (8-12 hours) until batter becomes light and airy
Pour batter into greased idli molds, filling 3/4 full
Steam in idli maker for 10-15 minutes until toothpick comes out clean
Cool slightly and push idlis out onto plate
Serve with sambar and coconut chutney
breakfast.notes: Fermentation is crucial for proper texture and flavor. The batter should have small air bubbles after fermentation
breakfast.fun_fact: Idlis require fermentation which enhances nutrition through microbial activity. Idlis are naturally gluten-free and highly digestible, making them suitable for those with gluten intolerance
alternatives: Serve with upma instead of sambar
Make instant idli with baking soda if in hurry

breakfast.name: Dosa (South Indian Crepe)
breakfast.description: Thin, crispy South Indian crepe made from fermented rice and lentil batter, typically served with sambar, coconut chutney, or potato curry
ingredients: Fermented dosa batter (from idli recipe above)
instructions: Heat non-stick griddle or tava over medium-high heat
Grease griddle lightly with oil
Pour 1/2 cup batter in center of pan
Immediately spread very thin in circular motion using ladle back
Drizzle oil around edges and under dosa
Cook for 1-2 minutes until bottom turns golden and crispy
Flip carefully and cook another 30 seconds
Fold and serve hot with sambar, chutney, or potato curry
breakfast.notes: Well-fermented batter creates naturally crispy, golden exterior. Spreading technique takes practice but is essential for proper thin crepe
breakfast.fun_fact: A well-fermented dosa batter creates a naturally crispy exterior while remaining soft inside. Some regions prepare masala dosa by adding spiced potato filling before folding
alternatives: Make masala dosa with potato filling

breakfast.name: Puri (Deep-Fried Indian Flatbread)
breakfast.description: Golden, puffy deep-fried flatbread from India, often served with curries like nihari or sabzi. The deep frying creates a light, airy, crispy texture
instructions: Mix flour and salt in bowl
Add oil and rub into flour
Gradually add warm water and knead into soft, smooth dough
Cover and rest dough for 20-30 minutes
Divide dough into 8 equal portions and roll each into thin circle (4-5 inches)
Heat oil for deep frying in heavy-bottomed pot to 350°F
Carefully place puri in hot oil - it will sink initially
Using slotted spoon, gently press down center so it puffs up
Flip after 10 seconds and fry other side until golden (about 20 seconds total)
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
Serve hot with nihari or other curries
breakfast.notes: Proper oil temperature is crucial - too cool and puris will be greasy, too hot and they'll brown before puffing
breakfast.fun_fact: Puri is served as an accompaniment to soak up delicious gravy of Nihari or other curries. The deep frying creates characteristic puffy texture that makes puris satisfying

breakfast.name: Nihari (Pakistani Beef Stew)
breakfast.description: A slow-cooked, deeply flavorful beef stew from Pakistan traditionally eaten for breakfast, made with bone-in beef and a complex spice blend including rare long pepper
instructions: Boil beef shank with water and salt until tender (45-60 minutes)
Heat ghee in large pot, add sliced onions
Cook covered over low heat for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until onions are very soft and golden
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook covered for 20 minutes over low heat
Mix all spices together and add to onions, stir well
Add cooked beef and its broth to spice mixture
Mix atta with small amount of water to make paste, add to curry to thicken
Simmer for 10 minutes until flavors meld
Serve hot with halved boiled eggs, topped with fried onions and fresh ginger
Accompany with puri bread
breakfast.notes: The slow cooking of onions for 45 minutes is crucial to developing the rich, complex flavor. Long pepper (peepli) is essential and irreplaceable
breakfast.fun_fact: Nihari is traditionally eaten as special weekend breakfast in Pakistani households. The essential spice peepli gives nihari its unique flavor profile
alternatives: Serve with naan instead of puri

breakfast.name: Aloo Gobi Paratha (Potato-Cauliflower Flatbread)
breakfast.description: A North Indian stuffed flatbread combining potato and cauliflower filling with warm spices, cooked on griddle with ghee until crispy and golden
instructions: Make dough: Mix flour and salt, add ghee and rub in, gradually add warm water, knead into soft dough
Cover dough and let rest 20-30 minutes
Make filling: Heat oil, add cumin seeds and let crackle (30 seconds)
Add ginger-chili paste and cook for 1 minute
Add grated cauliflower and fry for 2-3 minutes
Add coriander, turmeric, chaat masala, salt and pepper
Add mashed potatoes and cook until combined (2-3 minutes), cool filling
Divide dough into 4 balls, roll one into 4-inch circle
Place 3 tbsp filling in center, bring edges up and seal
Gently flatten into 1/4-inch thick disc and roll to 7-8 inches
Heat tava (griddle) over medium flame
Place paratha on tava and cook until golden spots appear (1-2 minutes)
Flip and cook other side, applying ghee with brush
Flip again and press with spatula so paratha cooks evenly and becomes crispy
Serve hot with green chutney and chai
breakfast.notes: The combination of two parathas (aloo and gobi) creates a more interesting and nutritious filling than either alone
breakfast.fun_fact: Aloo Gobi Paratha is a North Indian breakfast dish that is filling, satisfying, and comforting, combining two popular parathas with equal proportions of potato and cauliflower
alternatives: Top with raw onion and lemon

lunch.name: Samosa (Fried Pastry with Potato Filling)
lunch.description: Popular Indian lunch snack - crispy fried pastry triangles filled with spiced potatoes and peas. Every region has its own variation
instructions: Make dough: Mix flour, ghee, salt, add water gradually. Knead until soft. Rest 30 min
Make filling: Boil potatoes, peel, dice
Heat ghee, temper cumin seeds, add onions/chilies/ginger, cook 3 min
Add potatoes and peas, cook 5 min, cool
Roll dough thin, cut triangles, fill and fold sealing edges
Deep fry at 350°F until golden
Serve with chutney
lunch.notes: Proper sealing prevents oil from entering pastry during frying. Filling must be cool before sealing
lunch.fun_fact: Samosa is popular lunch and snack throughout India, eaten at tea time and festivals everywhere

lunch.name: Thali (Complete Indian Meal)
lunch.description: Balanced complete meal with rice, dal, vegetable curries, flatbread, pickle, yogurt and papad. Represents balanced Indian nutrition
instructions: Prepare rice, dal, and vegetable curries according to separate recipes
Make or buy papad
Cook flatbread on hot griddle
Arrange all items in metal or brass plate with small bowls
Serve with fresh yogurt and pickle condiments
Thali is eaten with all items together, mixing as desired
lunch.notes: Thali composition varies by region and season. Balance of proteins, vegetables, grains essential
lunch.fun_fact: Thali represents complete balanced meal of Indian cuisine. Every region has own unique thali with local specialties

dinner.name: Chicken Tikka Masala (Creamy Tomato-Based Chicken Curry)
dinner.description: Creamy tomato-based chicken curry - perfected in British Indian restaurants
instructions: Mix chicken with 150ml yogurt, half the ginger-garlic paste, 1/2 tsp garam masala, salt; marinate 20 minutes
Heat 1 tbsp ghee in skillet; grill or pan-fry chicken 10-12 minutes per side until lightly charred; set aside
Heat 2 tbsp ghee in large pan, add bay leaf, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves; toast 1 minute
Add onions, cook until golden brown (7-8 minutes)
Add remaining ginger-garlic paste, cook 2 minutes
Add cumin, coriander, turmeric, chili powder; cook 1 minute until fragrant
Add crushed tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes
Add cream and cashew paste; stir well
Return chicken to pan with remaining yogurt, garam masala
Simmer 10 minutes; garnish with cilantro
dinner.notes: Cashew paste creates creamy texture and adds richness
dinner.fun_fact: Perfected in British Indian restaurants in 1960s

dinner.name: Lamb Rogan Josh (Aromatic Lamb Curry)
dinner.description: Fragrant Kashmiri lamb curry - aromatic and deeply flavorful dinner
instructions: Heat ghee in large pot over medium heat
Add cumin seeds, let them splutter for 10 seconds
Add sliced onions, cook until golden brown (8-10 minutes)
Add ginger and garlic paste, cook 2 minutes
Add lamb pieces, brown on all sides (8 minutes)
Add bay leaves, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves
Cook spices for 1 minute until fragrant
Add ground coriander, turmeric, cayenne
Cook 1 minute
Add crushed tomatoes, cook 5 minutes
Add yogurt, stir well to combine
Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 60-70 minutes
Lamb should be very tender and sauce should coat the meat
Taste and adjust salt
Stir in kasuri methi and fresh cilantro
Serve with basmati rice or naan bread
dinner.notes: Low and slow cooking develops the complex flavors. Don't rush the onions
dinner.fun_fact: Rogan Josh originated in Kashmir but is beloved throughout India
